[mission_summary]
GTM LABS turns recorded webinars and long-form sessions into 30+ channel-ready assets in under 72 hours. We blend marketing strategy, human editing, and workflow automation so B2B SaaS teams keep their brand voice consistent while scaling output.

[core_offerings]
- Webinar → Content (Monthly): up to 2 webinars/month; 30+ assets each; 48 hour turnaround; 1 revision per asset.
- Founding Partner Program: $795/mo for first 6 months, then $995/mo; prioritized onboarding and co-marketing.
- Add-ons: landing page build (+$497/mo); advanced reporting (+$297/mo) with UTM + GA4 funnel dashboards.

[customer_profile]
Ideal client = Series A–C SaaS companies with recurring webinars, a growing email list, and lean marketing teams. Key buyer personas: VP/Director of Demand Gen, Head of Marketing, Content Lead.

[proof_points]
- 30+ assets delivered per webinar across blog, LinkedIn, email, clips, landing copy, and lead magnets.
- 72-hour draft turnaround with automated revision tracking.
- Integrated analytics: UTMs + GA4 download events, showing funnel from social → landing → subscriber.
